description: Reveal procedural specimens with an inertial circular scanner, then intercept only the requested silhouettes with action-triggered delayed localization pulses.
name: Reveal to Identify V2 · Non-real-time · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Start the survey and fully illuminate every shell to optically certify all numbered plates. Then tag only the requested silhouettes. In full mode, grab and drag the crosshair; SPACE emits. In simplified mode, click the tank to steer; PULSE emits. The numbered contact sheet retains exposed pixels and shows full glyphs after optical certification. Pulses arm only when every plate is certified. White arrows show velocity; blue arrows show the changing current. Each deliberate scanner action advances one fixed 120 ms simulation step; waiting leaves positions, flow, recharge and action opportunities unchanged. Firing completes its displayed fixed pulse flight as an action-triggered transition. A miss, protected tag, or incomplete certification ends the episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
